blocks.text: Every initiative is measured at three levels: what it produces, what changes because of it and what that adds to the 2035 case.

The framework is the written form of the M&E toolkit the SLA requires (clauses 1.1.4 and 1.1.10). It sets indicators, baselines and targets for arrivals, spend, jobs, airlift, cruise and SMME inclusion, with the tools to track them [clause wording to be checked against the signed Annexure B]. The Inception Report adds geographic spread and asks for definitions, sources, frequency, owners and governance for each indicator (Inception Report, Nov 2025, p23).

blocks.caption: Initiatives produce outputs Wesgro controls, which move outcomes Wesgro shares with partners, which add up to the 2035 impact.
